blurb: A&A Ballet provides training in strong, versatile dance techniques and develops personality, independence, and artistry. Founded by internationally acclaimed artists Anna Reznik and Alexei Kremnev, the school offers a wide variety of classes, private instruction, choreography, and professional performance opportunities. Students range from age 3 to adult and have been placed in top ballet companies worldwide.
